package.name: go2_action_bridge
package.description: Turns one word on /go2/action (std_msgs/String, "dance1") into ONE preset request for the Unitree Go2 (Dance1, api_id 1022), sent only from balance stand, never queued, then watched until the robot is back at rest. No abort path: it sends nothing else. ⛔ CAN PUBLISH TO THE ROBOT when armed. Kept apart from go2_cmd_bridge and go2_adapter. Audited by scripts/test_action_bridge_offline.py. Plan: friday_dance_demo_plan.md.
